author.name: Špela Arhar Holdt, Jakob Lenardič, Timotej Knez

description: Official LaTeX template for the Conference on Language Technologies and Digital Humanities (JTDH). Provides a compact custom page layout with sans-serif typography via IBM Plex, uppercase spaced section headings, English/Slovene abstract and keyword environments, APA-style citation and referencing via apacite, table and figure support, footnote and quote styling, and a Creative Commons license block, based on a custom jtdh style file requiring XeLaTeX or LuaLaTeX.
